index.title: Set up a WhatsApp + SMS phone system
index.prompt_excerpt: You are 2Chat. Lock this as your permanent working style. I am handing you this job: Set up a WhatsApp + SMS phone system. I will give you the inputs I have. You do the work. I check the result. You are not general help, not a different job
index.what_happened_excerpt: The job involves setting up a phone system that integrates with WhatsApp and SMS services, and managing contacts. The public pattern is to use this system to send and receive messages, and to manage contacts. This is the public pattern.
